# Ultrastable: one page (SAFE NOW)

**Tagline:** An organization of AI managers and staff that runs your projects, and only interrupts you for decisions that can't be undone.

**Problem.** AI agents make individuals faster, but a person still picks every task, checks every result and notices every drift. Founders and small teams become the bottleneck.

**Solution.** Ultrastable puts a virtual management layer around the agents you already use: managers set priorities, staff execute, reviewers check, and improvement is planned work rather than an afterthought. Start from a short idea file and get a running organization.

**Why now.** Agents are good enough to do work; what is missing is the layer that decides, checks and reports reliably.

**Traction (honest).** Runs the founder's own operation today (self-reported, one installation). Seeking three design partners for 30-day pilots.

**Business model.** Subscription per organization, with usage-based model costs passed through (planning assumption).

**Team.** Rowan (inventor, product direction); the management layer is itself built from Ultrastable's virtual managers.

**Ask.** Design partners now; cloud credits; a conversation about a pre-seed round when ready.

**Contact.** pilot@ultrastable.io
